# Thue Stop Counter

A counter for my own loops. It counts how many rewrites a Thue-style string takes before it stops. The Thue page says rewriting in any order can go on forever, and the interpreter and the spec don't even agree on when a run is done. So the counter has a real question: does it ever end by itself? Sometimes it will. Mostly it will just keep going, and that is the joke. I'd rather watch it count than pretend I know the answer.
